svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P06 BUDLUM INTEGRATION AND RESEARCH GAPS
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P06 · BUDLUM INTEGRATION AND RESEARCH GAPS
The device adds no new system. Every function maps onto a layer that exists in the tree today. This plate names the layers, the artefacts, and the seventeen things that are still missing.
A · THE MAP · device, validator, database, and the artefact in the tree that carries each one

g.text: display leaves, drivers, touch
continuous flexible battery core
camera module, sensors, privacy
radio and printed antennas
hardware decoder, secure element
wallet authority, never a key root
it holds a cache, never the only copy
safe screen and wallet approval are local
"a perception surface, a wallet authority
and a link" - that is the whole bill of materials

svg.text: THE VALIDATOR · three roles, three stakes

g.text: VALIDATOR, RoleId 1: the duty, blocks and votes
STORAGE_OPERATOR, RoleId 5: shards and challenges
AI_OPERATOR, RoleId 8: compute and results
RoleId is an open u32, so the registry stays extensible
effort tiers 0.5x to 10x: an operator advertises the depth
its hardware can serve, and a request above it is refused
rather than answered with cheaper work: it fails closed
the operator posts a compute bond, so a bad result costs it
the device keeps only what a network cannot supply:
scanout, the decoder, the secure element, the radios
a multi-format, lossless, quantum-resistant storage
core, the .bud v2 container, with a byte-level format
contract that carries its own measurements
content addressing, deals, challenge and response,
a QR and receipt line, and a settlement module
POLLEN stands in front of it: a consent-gated market
where a read without a grant is refused, strictly
session state, panel calibration, the geometry manifest
and the component records live here, not in the device
therefore the provider can change and the device cannot
Budscan: the decentralised browser. a name is
classified, checked against the name rule, resolved
through BNS or ENS, then fetched by one of four
fetchers, each declaring its own strength
the gateway emits evidence-labelled profiles and a
wallet context atlas: every statement carries a status
Lubot: a reading AI, an Android bridge today, with
secrets masked on the device before a question
leaves it
these are the applications the device needs,
none of them can run on the device itself

svg.text: the honest note: Budscan is a Gecko-based browser, the gateway is a service and Lubot is a client. the device renders frames; the engines run where the compute is.
B · WHAT ALREADY EXISTS AND THE DEVICE REUSES IT

g.text: src/network/mobile.rs · the Mobile Self profile: a node
on a phone, a battery-aware challenge policy, relay
and STUN traversal, self-hosted B.U.D. storage and
lightweight stateless sync.
src/light_client/ · succinct verification from one trust
anchor: BLS finality certificates and the post-quantum
quorum blob, with a transport-agnostic sync plan.
crates/budscan · the same discipline inside the
browser, with evidence labels and a light client.
crates/wallet-core · ML-DSA-87 signing with BIP39 and
SLIP-0010. a wallet, and explicitly not a relayer.
src/relayer/ · a permissionless relayer with a policy, a
worker, user intents, solver bids and settlement.
src/account_abstraction/ · quantum accounts, private
transfer authorization, TEE attestation, and a real
t-of-n multisig: t separate signatures verified one by
one. secret sharing was removed by design.
src/ai_inference/ · the model registry, the compute
bond, effort tiers, the perception declaration V3
enforced fail-closed at admission, STARK verification
on the transaction path.
src/pollen/ · the Data Rights gate: an AI read of stored
data is refused without a grant, and there is no override.
crates/note-packing · one packing for a note field
element, defined once, with compressed and encrypted
payloads and deterministic QR frames.
src/gateway/ · evidence-labelled profiles and the wallet
context atlas, read-only by construction.
docs/VALIDATOR_ROLES.md · the three roles and the
separate stakes, and the hardware-honesty rule of the
effort tiers.
every one of these was read over an API for this study.
no source tree is stored in the local workspace (W1).
the tree is the source of truth, and it is read, not copied.

svg.text: C · WHAT IS STILL MISSING · seventeen work orders for this device

g.text: RG-1 · a thin-client device profile: what a device with no SoC keeps and what it delegates.
RG-2 · the finality verification budget on a small secure element: BLS pairing and the post-quantum blob, measured.
RG-3 · a home for the display protocol. Pixel-Delta is a client transport, not a consensus layer. This is an architecture decision for Ayaz.
RG-4 · a live session handoff between operators: a session binding and a single-use resume token.
RG-5 · a stream perception declaration. V3 is per request and a viewfinder is continuous: a time lease is required.
RG-6 · a home and a reader for the component records: the schema, the storage in B.U.D. and a view in Budscan.
RG-7 · the signature transport budget: 4 627 bytes for an ML-DSA-87 signature and 2 592 for a public key. What travels, and over which path.
RG-8 · session-key authorization through the account-abstraction registry, so the wallet authorizes once instead of signing every tap.
RG-9 · the reverse battery policy: telemetry from the device to the validator so the render mode follows the cell state.
RG-10 · a relayer reachability and fee plan for a device behind a carrier NAT.
RG-11 · can a compute-free device still serve storage, and what is the lowest challenge cost that stays a verification and not a promise.
RG-12 · the optical transfer feature: a signed receipt or a small payload as QR frames when there is no radio at all.
RG-13 · a device and part identity anchor, so a replaced panel, core or module is authorized by the wallet and not by a factory key.
RG-14 · the Budscan render target: the engine at the validator, the frames and the delta protocol at the device.
RG-15 · a device telemetry schema for the battery, the thermal state, the panel and the link, under the Pollen rules.
RG-16 · an evidence UI rule: how an evidence label is rendered by a panel with no render engine.

svg.text: RG-17 · the naming rule of plate P02: the D-Web Passport is an identity profile, and the hardware record of a part is a COMPONENT RECORD.
D · THE INVENTION, STATED CAREFULLY · and the prior art that must be screened first

g.text: THE CLAIM SET FOR THE ATTORNEY
a device that keeps only the display, the radio, the battery and a perception module, and takes
all compute from a permissionless network of bonded operators under a wallet authority, with the
session portable across operators and no device change, and a signed perception declaration that the
network checks before it reads, enforced fail-closed at admission. a continuous 4-layer flexible battery
between two displays and an upright top-edge B module with bar antenna, front camera, and rear round AMOLED.
quality of service is chosen by trust first and latency second, with a stated ladder to satellite message mode.
THE PRIOR ART, RECORDED, NOT HIDDEN
thin clients and remote display, older than this program by decades
cloud gaming and cloud phones: one provider, one subscription, the identity of the provider
lapdocks and phone-as-computer docks: the phone stays the brain and nothing moves off it
magnetic camera modules: a phone in 2025, a whole module system on a phone in 2026
the difference this program must prove: the provider is a bonded, wallet-authorized set rather than a company,
and the identity, the data and the session survive a change of provider.
